title: Thai-Style Sunday Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-style rice pilaf perfect for a relaxing Sunday meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chapssalgaru rice and sweet rice, stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve hot.
